# Minimal by design. Built to keep up.

A fast, open-source coding agent for your Mac. It works on several tasks at once, while you keep the conversation going.

Free and MIT licensed. Use local models, your own API keys or a ChatGPT sign-in.

## Why Wavefunction

- 0 1 Agent apps keep growing Coding agents are turning into super apps, adding more with every release. Wavefunction goes the other way: less is more, simpler is better, and building comes first.

Keep the conversation going. Give it a task, then another, and another. Wavefunction splits the work across subagents, steers them as your plans change, and brings their work together.

## Computer use that leaves your Mac alone

Other agents take over your mouse, keyboard and screen to get things done. Wavefunction gets a desktop of its own, so you keep working while it clicks. Watch it, or take control at any time.

- Your Mac stays yours It never moves your pointer, types on your keyboard or records your screen. Its desktop is a local Docker container with its own browser and files, and a file reaches your Mac only when the agent hands it over, to a folder you allowed.

### Your Mac stays yours

- Secure sign-ins When a site needs your login, you sign in privately. The agent pauses and never sees what you type, and the chat stays signed in for next time.

Yes. Wavefunction is free and open source under the MIT license. You bring your own models or provider account; any model usage charges come from your provider.
